# horsie Provider

Manage a horsie server's configuration: model providers, model aliases, and the presets sessions are created from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "horsie" {
  # Also read from HORSIE_ENDPOINT and HORSIE_TOKEN.
  endpoint = "https://horsie.example.com"
  token    = var.horsie_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the horsie server, e.g. `https://horsie.example.com`. Falls back to the `HORSIE_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) A horsie agent token. Create one with `POST /api/device/tokens`; it is shown once and stored hashed, so it cannot be read back. Falls back to the `HORSIE_TOKEN` environment variable.
